sentences.text: Aalto Kirurgia Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-28 under the industry code 86220, medical specialists activities.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-07-28, and first sales are recorded on 2026-08-05.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a word that can mean waves in Finnish, but the registered industry is medical practice and the record shows no ocean use.
